title: Assessment Design in the AI Era: A Method for Identifying Items Functioning Differentially for Humans and Chatbots

bias_targets.target: Item bias (Human vs. AI differential performance)
bias_targets.methodology: Using Differential Item Functioning (DIF) methods, specifically Mantel-Haenszel (MH-DIF) and Logistic Regression (LR-DIF), to identify multiple-choice assessment items where chatbots and human learners with the same overall ability level exhibit systematically different probabilities of answering correctly.

primary_bias_target: Item bias (Human vs. AI differential performance)
